subject: Request: Trial continuity & temporary credits while PO clears
body:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Trial access — procurement routing delay, can we extend credits?

Hi Soojin,

Quick one — our procurement and legal teams have started routing the PO for Redwood but there was an internal queue and the approval is slipping into next week. We have active devs testing the integration and they'd like to keep running a few large jobs this week for benchmarking.

Is there any way Redwood can provide an interim extension or temporary promo credits so we don't lose the momentum? We expect to have a signed PO within 10–14 days but I don't have a hard date yet.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health
alex.rivera@nimbushealth.com

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:02:17 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial access — procurement routing delay, can we extend credits?

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for outlining the ETA. I can help with a short-term solution while procurement finishes the PO.

Before I pull the right approvals, can you confirm:
- Expected PO amount (ballpark) or SOW value you mentioned in the demo
- Whether legal requires an NDA/changes from our standard terms
- Whether you need credits applied to a single project/org or split across teams

Im looping in Dev (technical) and Marissa (account lead) to confirm operational limits. My initial thought: we can provision temporary trial credits (up to 25k tokens) and extend the trial window by 30 days conditioned on a PO submission within 30 days. If procurement ends up longer we can revisit.

If you can send a quick screenshot of the procurement status or tentative PO number that helps speed approval.

Onboarding next steps once PO is in: we'll convert trial usage to committed credits and kick off dedicated onboarding.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

---
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 13:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial access — procurement routing delay, can we extend credits?

+1 from the technical side. Nimbus has been running long sequences and a couple heavy embedding jobs. If we give a temporary credit bucket:
- Recommend we cap at 25,000 tokens (safe for additional benchmarks)
- Enable usage alerting at 60% consumption and a hard stop at 100% to avoid surprise billing
- Note: if they request increased throughput (more workers) we should gate that until PO is signed

I can set the alerts and the quota if Marissa confirms business ok.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial access — procurement routing delay, can we extend credits?

Thanks team. Approved: temporary promotional credits up to 25,000 tokens and a 30-day trial extension from today (June 9). Conditions:
- PO or signed SOW must be received within 30 days (by July 9).
- Credits are promotional only, non-refundable, and will be applied to the trial account ID provided by Soojin.
- If PO is delayed beyond 30 days, Soojin to re-escalate; we can consider a one-time 15-day bump but must document reasons.

Soojin: attaching the short agreement to send to Nimbus for signature (DocuSign link optional).

[Attachment: trial-credits-agreement.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)]

Marissa Cole
Account Leader | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 15:20:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial access — procurement routing delay, can we extend credits?

Alex — good news. Per Marissas approval, we have provisioned the following for Nimbus Health effective immediately:

- 25,000 promotional token credits added to your trial account (reference: Offer NIM-2345-PROMO)
- Trial window extended 30 days from today (new trial end date: 2026-07-09)
- Usage alerts at 60% and a hard stop when credits exhausted (you will not be billed without a signed contract)

Terms and next steps:
1) Please sign the attached short agreement. We can send via DocuSign if you prefer (link below).
2) Send the PO or tentative PO number when available and copy me. Well convert usage to the committed contract once PO is fully executed.
3) Dev has put the alerts and quota in place; if you hit the limit and still need more for the proof-of-concept, let me know and well evaluate.

Attachments and links:
- trial-credits-agreement.pdf (attached)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/2345
- DocuSign (optional signing): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?o=12345

If procurement would find it helpful I can include a short procurement note with legal contact details to speed review.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

---
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Megan Frost <megan.frost@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:32:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial access — procurement routing delay, can we extend credits?

Soojin — thank you, this is exactly what we needed. I attached a short procurement status snapshot showing approvals pending legal sign-off. Tentative PO number is PO-4852 (internal).

[Attachment: procurement_status.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)]

Well aim to have the signed PO to you by June 20; if legal needs extra time Ill request a one-time extension per your process. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the safeguards around usage alerts.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health
alex.rivera@nimbushealth.com
